verdict.rationale: AgentOS documents pre-built agent workflows including 'building cashflow reports' and 'cashflow management' skills, which implies some data-driven insight generation via AI agents, but this is framed as an external agent toolkit for action-taking (transfers, beneficiaries, cards) rather than a native in-product analytics/insights feature surfaced to users. Missing for 10: evidence of a built-in AI insights/suggestions panel or dashboard inside the Airwallex web app itself, and independent/hands-on confirmation that agent-generated 'reports' actually surface proactive suggestions rather than just executing user-directed tasks.
